rationale: Base station storage is at 99% with loop recording disabled, and the console shows active fault code E-402 ("recording storage full"). Live view works and all devices are online, ruling out the customer's broadband theory. New events stopped being recorded because local storage is full, matching the complaint that clips stop after the 3rd.

repair_steps: Guide customer to enable loop recording: Base Station Settings > Storage > toggle Loop Recording ON.
If customer wants to keep existing clips, first export them via the app, then format storage.
Confirm error E-402 clears and new events are recorded.
output.customer_reply: Thanks for your patience. The issue is not your internet; your base station's local storage is full (99%) and loop recording is off, so new clips can't be saved. To fix, enable loop recording in Base Station Settings > Storage, or export important clips and format storage. This will allow new recordings. Let me know if you need help with these steps.

results.text: Base station storage at or above 98 percent with loop recording disabled. Frontline action: enable loop recording or format storage.

Event clips are stored on the base station's internal eMMC (HB-100: 16 GB, HB-200: 32 GB). When loop recording is disabled and storage reaches 98 percent, new events are not recorded and error E-402 is shown. Enable loop recording in Base Station Settings > Storage, or format the storage after exporting clips.

results.text: SEN-M1 on firmware 1.1 stopped reporting after base update to 4.5 with E-305. OTA to 1.4 succeeded and alerts resumed. Resolved at frontline. Note: initially escalated unnecessarily - an example of avoidable FAE workload.

complaint: Our camera recordings stopped about two weeks ago. Live view works fine, but there are no new clips in the event list after the 3rd. I think the internet must be dropping at night, our broadband has been flaky. Should I call my internet provider about it?
